title: Statistical Reporting & Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Overview:
Stratus is seeking a detail-oriented and data-driven Statistical Reporting & Compliance Analyst to support our regulatory reporting operations across Property & Casualty lines of business. This role will be responsible for compiling, validating, and submitting timely and accurate statistical filings and reports to various regulatory bodies and statistical agencies including ISO, NCCI, NISS, and state insurance departments. The ideal candidate will have strong reconciliation skills, working knowledge of SQL, and prior experience with insurance compliance and statistical reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual statistical filings to state insurance departments, Advisory Organizations (ISO, NCCI, NISS), and other insurance bureaus.
  • Run monthly edit programs to identify and correct data issues, ensuring data integrity before submission.
  • Create and execute queries to monitor the accuracy and completeness of data submitted by agents, MGAs, and Program Administrators.
  • Retrieve and compile policy-level data from internal systems for various P&C lines of business.
  • Analyze reoccurring data errors; develop and implement corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.
  • Reconcile statistical call data with state Annual Statement figures to verify reporting accuracy.
  • Minimize penalties related to late, missing, or incorrect filings through timely and accurate submissions.
  • Respond to complex data requests from state departments and statistical agencies.
  • Prepare transmittal forms, affidavits, and other official documentation required for data calls and regulatory submissions.
  • Ensure the accuracy of catastrophe-related data reported to state insurance departments.
  • Maintain and update statistical reporting manuals and documentation to reflect current regulatory requirements and internal processes.
  • Cross-train across multiple statistical plans to ensure team versatility and compliance continuity.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in insurance statistical reporting, regulatory compliance, or a similar role within the P&C insurance industry.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying and validation.
  • Strong data reconciliation and analytical skills.
  • Familiarity with reporting requirements of ISO, NCCI, NISS, and state departments of insurance.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills for responding to complex regulatory inquiries.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
